market.summary: A sharp global sell-off overnight points to a gap-down open after yesterday's 9-month high. Wall Street fell about 2% as investors sold AI stocks after Anthropic's market debut, and Japan and Korea are down over 4% this morning. GIFT Nifty is about 190 points lower (~0.6-0.7%). Foreign investors were still strong buyers yesterday, which may cushion the fall; expect a weak open and check closes against your 10 EMA levels rather than reacting to the first hour.

points.text: US close 19 Nov: Dow 49,097 (-1,101 pts, -2.19%), S&P 500 7,176 (-2.02%), Nasdaq Composite -2.25%; AI-stock profit taking after Anthropic's IPO, AMD down about 8-9%.
Asia this morning: Nikkei about -4.5%, Kospi about -4.4%, Hang Seng -1.6%, Shanghai -1.7%.
GIFT Nifty about 25,340 (-190 pts) before the open vs Nifty's 25,514 close yesterday.
NSE provisional 19 Nov: FIIs net bought ₹7,411 Cr, DIIs net sold ₹1,357 Cr; FIIs about +₹1.15 lakh Cr in November so far (NSDL).

US 10-year yield above 5% after Fed officials signalled more hikes; Brent about $92.5; West Asia tension (tanker hits in the Strait of Hormuz reported). Trump-Xi talks made little progress on tariffs and chips.

market.watch: Size of the gap-down and whether Nifty holds the ~25,300 support named last evening; judge exits on the close, not the open.

Groww closed only ₹0.87 above its 10 EMA (₹220.02) and a broker stock tends to fall with the market, so today's gap-down could produce a close below it: that would be the sell-half signal. The stop is at cost, so the trade's gain is protected either way.
